entries.001190754cc9b7cb: The company sells apparel and miscellaneous goods at directly operated stores, and apparel, miscellaneous goods and lifestyle products on EC sites. Sales in the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥12,656 million, exceeding the previous fiscal year owing to strong miscellaneous goods shops and growth in EC sales. The filing company has 14 stores.
entries.060e3ec1b343c598: Manufacturing and wholesale of lifestyle products such as seasonal sundries, beauty products, healthcare products and fashion sundries, sold to specialty stores, mass merchants, drugstores, home centers, convenience stores and others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥2,577 million. The new variety-shop sundry brand "Yoki" is expanding, and consolidated subsidiary IS Link Co., Ltd. manufactures and wholesales cosmetics.
entries.27993bd5328eb571: Child development support services and other services provided by consolidated subsidiary Discovery Plus Co., Ltd. Revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥416 million.

entries.793235e06f822eb4: Manufacturing and wholesale of lifestyle products such as seasonal sundries, beauty products, healthcare products and fashion sundries, sold to specialty stores, mass merchants, drugstores, home centers, convenience stores and others.
entries.c84b58ab0cd6f5a5: An apparel group centered on the manufacture and wholesale of women's clothing, with wholesale of lifestyle products and retail at stores and through EC.
entries.ca32d2251da9f71b: Child development support services and other services provided by consolidated subsidiary Discovery Plus Co., Ltd.
entries.d49ed3e1d3eff4da: This is the business of the group, consisting of the company and 5 consolidated subsidiaries, whose main business is the planning, manufacture and sale of apparel and lifestyle products, and which also conducts retail sales through stores and EC. The company's main business is the manufacture and wholesale of women's apparel, sold to specialty stores, mass retailers, non-store channels and others, and in the manufacture and wholesale of lifestyle products it also sells to drugstores, home centers, convenience stores and others. Third Office Co., Ltd. conducts the manufacture and wholesale of men's apparel, IS Link Co., Ltd. the manufacture and wholesale of cosmetics, Style Plus Co., Ltd. the planning and sale of apparel products and consulting, Kelesipulesi (Shanghai) Fushi Zhengli Co., Ltd. inspection, needle detection and logistics processing in China, and Discovery Plus Co., Ltd. child development support services.
entries.e629199b18cccabe: Manufacturing and wholesale centered on women's apparel, sold to specialty stores, mass merchants, non-store retailers and others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥44,202 million. The company is focusing on strengthening its functional fashion brand "Cross Function" and expanding its men's business, and its consolidated subsidiary Third Office Co., Ltd. manufactures and wholesales men's apparel to specialty stores.
